O mapa das resenhas. Quem faz festa, sho: The hangout map. People throwing a party, a show, a college party, a birthday or a street get-together put it on the map. People looking for something to do open it and see what's on now, today or this weekend, close to where they are.
Todo fim de semana alguém pergunta \"o q: Every weekend someone asks "what is there to do today?", and the answer is scattered everywhere: a story here, a WhatsApp group there, a poster taped to a lamppost. Resenhópolis started in Juiz de Fora (MG) to bring all of that into one place, with each get-together pinned to the right spot on the map.
Pra quem quer sair e ainda não sabe pra: For people who want to go out but don't know where yet, and for people organizing something who want everyone to hear about it. Browsing the map is free and doesn't require signing up. Creating an account is only for people 18 or older.
Como achar um rolê: How to find something to do
Se você liberar a localização, o mapa ab: If you allow location access, the map opens near you. You can also search for another city by name. Filters cut out what you don't care about:
horário: agora, hoje ou fim de semana (o: time: now, today or this weekend ("today" runs until 6 a.m. the next day, because parties don't end at midnight);
tipo de rolê e público, como 18+, univer: type of get-together and audience, such as 18+, college students, LGBTQIA+, family or 30+;
as mais bem avaliadas, com 4 estrelas ou: the top-rated ones, with 4 stars or more.
Cada resenha mostra quando e onde é, qua: Each hangout shows when and where it is, how much entry costs and how many people are going. If the person who posted it provided them, you also see the organizer's Instagram and the link to tickets or the guest list. The "Como chegar" (Directions) button opens the route in Google Maps.
Com conta: Eu vou, check-in e avaliação: With an account: I'm going, check-in and ratings
Entrando com uma conta Google ou Apple,: When you sign in with a Google or Apple account, you can tap "Eu vou" (I'm going), follow recurring hangouts and see which friends are going. Friendships are made through an invite link, and your attendance only shows to friends if you turn on "Mostrar para amigos" (Show to friends).
Chegou no lugar? O botão \"Cheguei! Faze: Made it there? The "Cheguei! Fazer check-in" (I'm here! Check in) button sends your location just once, only to confirm that you're really at the hangout. The app keeps a record that you checked in to that edition. It doesn't keep your location.
Depois que a edição começa, dá pra dar d: Once the edition starts, you can give it 1 to 5 stars and leave a comment. It's one rating per person per edition, so a recurring party gets a new score every time. People who went can also send photos and videos from the day. They go through an automatic check for inappropriate content before everyone can see them and are deleted 180 days after the edition.
Toque no mapa no lugar onde vai ser e pr: Tap the map where it's going to happen and fill in the form: name, time, place, entry and audience. Instagram, ticket link and description are optional. A hangout can happen just once or repeat, for example every week, every last Friday of the month or on the 15th of every month.
A primeira resenha de cada conta é gráti: Each account's first hangout is free. After that, posting costs R$ 2.00 per hangout. On the website, payment is by Pix through Mercado Pago; in the app, the charge comes from the store you downloaded it from. The hangout only goes on the map once payment is confirmed. The fee is there to hold back spam and fake hangouts, and it doesn't buy visibility or approval.
Resenha que se repete fica um mês no map: A recurring hangout stays on the map for one month with the posting fee. From the second month on, it costs R$ 1.00 per month to keep showing. Nothing is charged automatically: each month is a new payment, and you get a reminder 3 days before the due date and on the day itself.
Pra ninguém brigar por lugar, cada local: So nobody fights over a spot, each place accepts one hangout per day, with at least 4 hours between the end of one and the start of the next. Whoever posted it can edit it up to 2 days before it starts and cancel it at any time. Canceling doesn't refund the fee, but you can still request a refund by e-mail within 7 days of payment, as provided by Brazil's Consumer Protection Code.
